description: If I was stranded on a desert island and could only have 3 AI tools to make ad creative… @ElevenLabs would be one of them. Here are some of my favorite voiceover tests to run right now: 1. Whisper Hooks: simply change the hook into a whisper. It gives great ASMR vibes and we’ve seen it shoot up hook rates too. 2. Change the gender: this can help you target a new demographic… or like us you’ll find that your current demo actually responds better it. 3. Run an objection handling test: develop a creative test specifically around the major objections your buyer have pre-purchase. Then test the different voices of your core personas in each variation (age, gender, dialect) Tell me: have you done voiceover tests yet? #ElevenCreativePartner
transcript: Okay, so each of these ads made my client over 125 k in revenue, and they all had one thing in common. Can you guess what it is? Well, we used 11 Labs voice over in every single one. So here are three of my favourite voice over iterations so that you can make even more revenue for your clients. Number one, change the voice over to a whisper. Honestly, just even doing this in the hook can give amazing ASMR vibes. That actually drives performance. And number two, change the gender of the voiceover. In fact, in this one, we actually changed it from a female voiceover to a male voiceover. And while our initial intention was to drive to a new demographic, aka men, we actually still ended up delivering to primarily affluent women through this voice over. But it drove even better performance. And now that we have this learning, this is something that we actually want to use in a future partnership ad with a creator. And number three, do an objection handling test using three different voices that represent three of your main personas. Using 11 Labs, you're gonna be able to customize voice based on age, gender, and even dialect so that you'll be able to drive more creative diversity in your ad accounts and ultimately, performance. So let me know in the comments, are you using 11 Labs yet, and if not, why?
